subsystems.name: Neuron circuits
subsystems.role: mimic biological neurons by integrating incoming signals and emitting a spike when a threshold is crossed, then leaking back down.

subsystems.name: Synapse array
subsystems.role: stores the weights that scale each connection.

subsystems.name: Spike routing network
subsystems.role: delivers sparse events only where and when they are needed, rather than clocking every wire.

subsystems.name: Learning engine
subsystems.role: adjusts weights on the chip using local rules instead of a separate training pass.

subsystems.name: Event-based I/O
subsystems.role: connects to sensors that output changes rather than full frames.

subsystems.name: Software stack
subsystems.role: maps a trained spiking network onto the hardware and controls it.

buildSteps.title: Pick the neuron model
buildSteps.detail: Choose a simple integrate-and-fire model and a learning rule such as STDP that can be built in silicon.

buildSteps.title: Design the synapse fabric
buildSteps.detail: Lay out a crossbar of resistive memory cells or an SRAM array, sized so weights fit on-chip and are read at low energy.

buildSteps.title: Fabricate the chip
buildSteps.detail: Standard CMOS wafers are processed at a foundry; memristor layers may be deposited on top in a back-end step that must not damage the transistors below.

buildSteps.title: Build the event network
buildSteps.detail: Wire neurons together with an asynchronous, clockless interconnect that routes spikes by address, so idle parts draw almost no power.

buildSteps.title: Add learning circuitry
buildSteps.detail: Place local circuits that compare spike timing at each synapse and nudge the weight up or down.

buildSteps.title: Test and characterise
buildSteps.detail: Measure energy per spike, latency and accuracy against conventional neural networks; device-to-device variation in analog weights is a major issue.

buildSteps.title: Package and integrate
buildSteps.detail: Combine the chip with event cameras, microphones or prosthetic sensors in a low-power module.

buildSteps.title: Program with a compiler
buildSteps.detail: A software tool converts a trained spiking network into a hardware configuration, then the device runs and adapts in the field.
